Daraz Pakistan — Customer Support & Buyer
Policy Knowledge Base
Purpose: RAG testing knowledge base for an e-commerce assistant.
Important: This is a developer-created testing dataset. It is not an official Daraz document. Policy details can change; production
systems should retrieve the latest official policy pages.
Reference basis: Daraz Pakistan official Terms, Buyer Policy, Help Center and Contact Us pages.
1. Customer Support
• Daraz provides a Help Center and customer-support routes for order tracking, returns, cancellations and other
questions.
• Customers can use the online return form to start an eligible return.
• Customers can use the online cancellation process where cancellation is available.
• Daraz's official contact/support page directs customers to its Help Center and relevant self-service tools.
2. Buyer Account & Platform Conduct
• Buyers are expected to follow Daraz platform terms and buyer-policy rules.
• Fraudulent activity, fake transactions and misleading activity are prohibited.
• Transactions originating on Daraz should be completed within the Daraz platform.
• Customers should not move Daraz transactions to offline payments or unrelated platforms.
• Official communication channels should be used for Daraz-related buyer/seller communications.
3. Reviews & Feedback
• Customers are expected to provide honest feedback about products and services.
• Fake, misleading, irrelevant, discriminatory, threatening or unlawful reviews/content are prohibited under the buyer
policy.
4. Payments & Safety
• Daraz terms state that platform transactions should use the platform's payment mechanisms.
• Customers should be cautious of requests for offline payments or transactions outside Daraz.
• Daraz states that it is not liable for transactions made outside the platform.
5. Escalation & Troubleshooting
• For an order issue, first identify the order and check its current status.
• For return issues, check eligibility, return window and return-condition requirements.
• For refund issues, identify the payment method and check the applicable refund timeline.
• For unresolved problems, use the official Daraz Help Center or Contact Us route.

6. FAQ Retrieval Examples
• Q: How do I contact Daraz about an order? A: Use the official Help Center or Contact Us support routes.
• Q: Can I pay a seller outside Daraz? A: Daraz's buyer policy says transactions should remain within the Daraz
platform.
• Q: Can I post any review I want? A: Reviews should be honest and must comply with the buyer-policy rules.
• Q: What should I do when I have a refund problem? A: Check the refund method/timeline first, then contact official
support if needed.

Daraz Pakistan — Delivery & Order Tracking
Knowledge Base
Purpose: RAG testing knowledge base for an e-commerce assistant.
Important: This is a developer-created testing dataset. It is not an official Daraz document. Policy details can change; production
systems should retrieve the latest official policy pages.
Reference basis: Daraz Pakistan official Terms, Help Center and customer-support pages.
1. Delivery Overview
• Delivery status can be checked through Daraz order tracking tools and the customer's order area.
• Customers should provide a complete and accurate shipping address.
• A customer should normally accept delivery even when an item appears defective or incorrect and then follow the
applicable Daraz return process.
2. Order Status Concepts
• Pending: an order has been received and is awaiting processing in the relevant seller workflow.
• Ready to Ship: the product is physically available, packed according to applicable requirements and ready for
transfer for delivery.
• Shipped: the product has been dispatched and is on course for delivery.
• Rejected Product: a product that has been shipped but could not be successfully delivered.
3. Tracking a Customer Order
• Customers can use the order tracking feature to check status updates.
• Daraz may provide order updates through channels such as email or SMS.
• The tracking number can be used where the applicable tracking service provides it.
4. Delivery Problems
• If a delivery is delayed, the customer should first check the current order status and tracking information.
• If the received item is damaged, defective, incorrect or incomplete, the customer should use the return process
rather than rejecting delivery solely for that reason.
• For unresolved issues, customers can use Daraz customer support and the Help Center.
5. Cancellation & Delivery
• Cancellation availability depends on the order stage and applicable policy.
• Seller-side processing requirements can apply after an order has reached shipped status.
• A seller should not dispatch an order that has already been cancelled before shipment.

6. FAQ Retrieval Examples
• Q: Where can I check my order? A: Use the Daraz order/tracking tools from your account.
• Q: What should I do if the delivered product is wrong? A: Accept the delivery and initiate the applicable return

• Q: What does Ready to Ship mean? A: The product is prepared and ready to be transferred for delivery.
• Q: What should I do if my order has not arrived? A: Check tracking first, then contact Daraz support if the issue
remains unresolved.

Daraz Pakistan — Returns & Refunds Knowledge
Base
Purpose: RAG testing knowledge base for an e-commerce assistant.
Important: This is a developer-created testing dataset. It is not an official Daraz document. Policy details can change; production
systems should retrieve the latest official policy pages.
Reference basis: Daraz Pakistan official Returns Policy, Refund Policy and Returns & Refunds FAQ pages.
1. Return Window
• For eligible products, a return request generally must be raised within 14 days from the date of delivery.
• Products marked as non-returnable on the product page are not eligible for return.
• After the 14-day return period, a customer should check whether a seller or brand warranty applies.
2. Common Valid Return Reasons
• Damaged product: the product is physically damaged or broken when delivered.
• Defective product: the product does not function as expected.
• Incorrect product: wrong product, size, colour, fake item, or expired item was delivered.
• Incomplete product: required items, accessories, or components are missing.
• Product does not match its description or picture.
• For selected categories, change-of-mind returns may be available.
3. Return Conditions
• The item should normally be unused, unworn, unwashed and without flaws. Fashion items may be tried on for fit
while still being considered unworn.
• Original tags, manuals, warranty cards, freebies, invoice and accessories should be included where applicable.
• The original manufacturer packaging should be returned in an undamaged condition.
• The order number and return tracking number should be indicated on the return package.
4. How to Start a Return
• Open the Daraz app or website and go to My Orders.
• Select the relevant order and choose the return option.
• Complete the online return form and select an available pickup or drop-off option.
• Pack the item securely and attach the return label.
• Drop the parcel at the designated location or wait for pickup.
5. Refund Basics
• A refund is processed after the eligible return goes through the applicable quality-check process.

5. Refund Basics
• A refund is processed after the eligible return goes through the applicable quality-check process.
• The refund method and timing depend on the original payment method and the selected refund option.
• Shipping charges may be included in the refunded amount for eligible returns.
6. FAQ Retrieval Examples
• Q: How many days do I have to request a return? A: Generally 14 days from delivery for eligible products.
• Q: Can I return a product because I changed my mind? A: Only for categories where change-of-mind returns are
permitted.
• Q: What happens if the returned item does not meet the return conditions? A: Daraz may reject the refund request
and send the item back according to its policy.
• Q: Do I have to return the whole order? A: No. Eligible individual products can be returned without returning the
entire order.

Daraz Pakistan — Seller & Seller Payments
Knowledge Base
Purpose: RAG testing knowledge base for an e-commerce assistant.
Important: This is a developer-created testing dataset. It is not an official Daraz document. Policy details can change; production
systems should retrieve the latest official policy pages.
Reference basis: Daraz Pakistan official Marketplace Agreement and Seller Center/Help Center information.
1. Seller Basics
• A Daraz seller uses Seller Center to manage products, orders, account information and seller operations.
• Sellers are expected to provide accurate product information, including descriptions, images, pricing, availability
and relevant product details.
• Sellers must comply with Daraz platform policies and applicable requirements.
2. Product Listing Requirements
• Product listings should contain accurate descriptions and specifications.
• Images should accurately represent the product and comply with applicable image guidelines.
• Sellers should provide correct stock, shipping and product information.
• Counterfeit, dangerous, prohibited or restricted products may not be listed where prohibited by applicable platform
rules or law.
3. Seller Returns & Quality Checks
• Seller-side return cases can include defective/damaged, incorrect and incomplete products.
• Change-of-mind returns may apply only to certain categories.
• Returned products can be subject to a Daraz quality-control check to assess the customer's return claim.
• If a return claim is found invalid under the applicable process, the product may be sent back to the customer.
4. Seller Payments
• Seller payments are connected to orders that reach the required delivered status and are subject to the applicable
settlement policy.
• Daraz provides payment information/statements through Seller Center.
• Payments are made in Pakistani Rupees to the bank account specified by the seller in Seller Center.
• Incorrect or incomplete bank-account information can affect successful payment processing.
• If a previously paid order is later returned, Daraz may deduct the equivalent amount in a subsequent settlement
cycle subject to the applicable policy.

5. Seller Support
• Seller Center/Help Center provides areas for claims, concerns, order management, payments, returns and policy
guidance.
• Seller support channels may include help-center resources and live support during published operating hours.
6. FAQ Retrieval Examples
• Q: Where are seller payment statements available? A: Through Seller Center.
• Q: What can cause a seller payment problem? A: Incorrect or incomplete bank-account information is one
documented cause.
• Q: Are all change-of-mind returns accepted? A: No. They apply only to certain categories under the return policy.
• Q: What happens to a returned seller product? A: The applicable process can include a Daraz quality-control
check.
